# PockKit interface files

These two files come from [PockKit](https://github.com/pock/pockkit) 0.2.0, © Pock, released under the MIT license (see `LICENSE`).
They're included only so the widget can compile against Pock's widget API. At runtime the widget uses the PockKit framework that ships inside Pock.app.

- `PockKit/Sources/Protocols/PKWidget.swift`
- `PockKit/Sources/Protocols/PKWidgetPreference.swift`
